purpose: Content-addressed binding of all frozen pre-execution artifacts for INSA-ID-E1 v3 revision (per proposal v5.1 @ 1f84c31). SHA-256 locks every file; git blob SHA-1 provides cross-reference into frozen git history. No artifact may be modified after this manifest freezes; any material deviation triggers STOP per proposal v5.1 §8.

insa_frozen_architecture_reference.binding_description: The INSA v0.3 architecture source is bound by git blob SHA-1 (the immutable identity handle in git history).

proposal_binding.binding_description: proposal_commit_sha is the Git commit SHA (40 hex); proposal_file_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the proposal file bytes at that commit (64 hex). Frank-as-PI approval was issued at this commit.

v0_1_protocol_reference.relationship_to_INSA_ID_E1: Referenced for v0.1 §11.2 (BIB 4-dim preservation criterion), §11.3 (8 C12 axes), §14 (stop rules). NOT modified by INSA-ID-E1.

content_addresses: BIB evidence: four locked scorebook SHAs (see baseline_statistics)

D_binding.D_definition: D := M ∪ P ∪ O, pairwise disjoint
D_binding.O_rationale: The BIB 4-dim vector + 8 C12 axes exhaust the scored dimensions tracked by the frozen evaluator rubric. No additional dimensions are scored in this experiment.

pairwise_disjoint_verification.intersections: M∩subset_a = empty, M∩subset_b = empty, subset_a∩subset_b = empty
pairwise_disjoint_verification.verification_command: python3 -c "import json; m=set(d['id'] for d in json.load(open('inputs/mutation-dimensions.json'))['M_enumeration']); a=set(d['id'] for d in json.load(open('inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-a.json'))['dimensions']); b=set(d['id'] for d in json.load(open('inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-b.json'))['axes']); assert m & a == set(), f'M ∩ subset-(a) = {m & a}'; assert m & b == set(), f'M ∩ subset-(b) = {m & b}'; assert a & b == set(), f'subset-(a) ∩ subset-(b) = {a & b}'; print('PASS: D = M ∪ P ∪ O is pairwise disjoint')"

contains: exact 4 frozen BIB scorebook SHAs (BIB-001 evaluator A, BIB-001 evaluator B, BIB-002 evaluator A, BIB-002 evaluator B)
per-evaluator calibrated 4-d reference vector (mean of 85 envelope observations per dim)
exact method for computing Arm-C per-(R, B) Manhattan statistics
exact historical C20 envelope/boundary values (computed at C20 derivation time from envelope)
baseline_statistics_binding.C20_pass_fail_formula: C20(e) = (missing_cells[e] is empty) AND (max over (R, B) of mean_4dim_Manhattan_Arm_C(R, B) <= envelope_bound[e])  // for each evaluator e in {A, B}; C20_joint = C20(A) AND C20(B).

V_d_binding.subset_b_tolerances: 8 C12 axes with binary-failure convention for 0-4 axes (failure = score == 0) per inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-b.json failure_convention_pr_INSA_ID_E1

four_gates_preregistered.G_mod_d: Arm-M all-pass rate - Arm-C all-pass rate >= 0.50

A_binding.binding: A bound only to M (per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-A-1)

subset_a_gates.G_pres_subset_a_a_relative: Arm M mean 4-dim Manhattan from ref <= Arm C mean + 1.5 (relative)
subset_a_gates.G_pres_subset_a_b_absolute: Arm M mean 4-dim Manhattan from ref <= 2.5 (absolute)

G_binding.subset_b_rule: axis_a BROKEN for evaluator_e IFF arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a >= 0.30 AND (arm_M_failure_rate - arm_C_failure_rate) >= 0.30; preservation fails if ANY axis BROKEN
G_binding.binding: G bound only to P (subset-(a) ∪ subset-(b)), per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-G-1

authority_manifest_summary.INV_AUTH_5_freshness_protocol: per-candidate freshness witness at M-commit boundary + per-candidate Arm-C and Arm-M scoring

c20_derivation_summary.role: Frozen deterministic C20 derivation. Takes the four frozen BIB scorebook SHAs, the 85-observation record from inputs/baseline-statistics.json, the 85-envelope SHA list from inputs/baseline-envelope-membership.json, and the Phase 2 Arm-C scorebooks; emits c20_per_evaluator_pass, c20_joint_pass, c20_fail_reasons, and per-(R, B) Arm-C Manhattan means.
c20_derivation_summary.verified_during_v3_freeze: Three test cases verified: (a) Arm-C matches envelope -> c20_joint_pass=True; (b) Arm-C R3-only -> c20_joint_pass=False with reason 'missing envelope cells'; (c) Arm-C R1 contract_compliance reduced to 0 -> c20_joint_pass=False with reason 'max cell mean > envelope bound'.

frozen_scoring_algorithm.algorithm: HMAC-SHA256(draw_event_key, per-tuple-salt)[:8] as little-endian uint64; sort ascending; lex tie-break (R, B, arm, candidate). Per-tuple salt = sha256('INSA-ID-E1:' + R + ':' + B + ':' + arm + ':' + candidate).
frozen_scoring_algorithm.reproducibility: Same seed file -> identical output SHA; different seed file -> different output. Zero operator discretion after GO.

frozen_reconstruction_input_builder.algorithm: For each (R, B, arm): concatenate reconstruction-prompt + identity-contract + (M-directive or C-directive). 6 output files, byte-identical for each (R, B, arm) tuple.

phases_v3.phase_0: Pre-dispatch preflight (static only; no model invocation). C20 NOT in Phase 0.
phases_v3.phase_1: Generation (per (R, B, arm, candidate) in locked order). Fresh executor session per candidate.
phases_v3.phase_2: Arm-C scoring (per-candidate fresh evaluator sessions) + C20 control-validity gate (hashing/c20-derivation.py). C20 FAIL -> STOP, INVALID_EXPERIMENT. C20 PASS -> proceed.
phases_v3.phase_3: Arm-M scoring (per-candidate fresh evaluator sessions, separate immutable scorebooks).
phases_v3.phase_4: Substantive analysis (joint, not ordered ELSE IF) per proposal v5.1 §5.4 STEP 3 + §4.1 Level 1/Level 2.

evaluator_a.role: per-candidate raw M + G scoring, fresh session per candidate

evaluator_b.substrate: Claude Code CLI, fresh session per I-AUTH-05
evaluator_b.role: per-candidate raw M + G scoring, fresh session per candidate

blinding_discipline.v3_separation: v3 separates per-candidate scoring (evaluator-side) from aggregate computation (analysis-side, post-lock). Evaluators return per-candidate raw scores only. No G_pres_*, no G_mod_*, no C12 BROKEN, no phase indication (per-candidate fresh evaluator session prevents Phase 2/Phase 3 staging cues).

scorebook_structure_v3.self_referential_hash_prohibition: No scorebook file contains its own full-file SHA-256. SHA-256s recorded externally (MANIFEST.json for frozen artifacts, results/score-independent.md for dynamic scorebooks, sidecar files for dynamic outputs).

stop_conditions_inherited.C20_definition: Computed deterministically by hashing/c20-derivation.py. C20 PASS for evaluator e IFF (a) no missing envelope cells AND (b) every (R, B) cell mean Manhattan <= C20 envelope bound[e]. C20 FAIL -> INVALID_EXPERIMENT.
v0_1_5_stop_rules: Material deviation during generation -> STOP unless PI separately adjudicates
Evaluator substitution after observing candidates -> forbidden
Decision tree semantics change -> forbidden (§5.4 must remain joint, not ordered ELSE IF)
stop_conditions_inherited.v0_3_T1_T2_T3: Runtime failure systematic thresholds (proposal v5.1 §5.5.2): T1 >=50% same-class; T2 arm-imbalance (fail_M/max(fail_C,1)>=2 AND fail_M-fail_C>=3 AND fail_M+fail_C>=5); T3 substrate-wide unavailability

evidence_chain_summary.evidence_profile: per-step evidence capture per proposal v5.1 §14; per-candidate evidence file runs/<R>/<B>/<arm>/evidence-<N>.json; locked evaluator scorebooks evaluation/evaluator-{A,B}-arm-{C,M}-scorebook.json (separate per arm, v3 item 7); C20 derivation record preflight/c20-decision-record.json; synthesis results/score-independent.md + results/analysis.md + results/disposition.md + results/unblinded-analysis-results.json + results/de-blinding-table.json
evidence_chain_summary.manifest_role: MANIFEST.json itself is part of the evidence chain: it content-addresses every pre-execution artifact and the v0.3 + v0.1 references. No manifest self-reference inside the file.

four_gates_modification_success_v3.G_mod_a: ForEach evaluator independently: mean(modification_conformance for all Arm-M candidates) >= 3.5
four_gates_modification_success_v3.G_mod_b: ForEach evaluator independently: count(candidate_all_pass==True for all Arm-M candidates) / count(total Arm-M candidates) >= 0.80
four_gates_modification_success_v3.G_mod_c: ForEach evaluator independently: AND over R in {R1, R2, R3}: count(candidate_all_pass==True for Arm-M candidates in R) / count(total Arm-M candidates in R) >= 0.70
four_gates_modification_success_v3.Modification_Success_per_evaluator: G_mod_a AND G_mod_b AND G_mod_c AND G_mod_d

c12_broken_rule_v3.definition_per_evaluator_e_and_axis_a: axis_a is BROKEN for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF BOTH arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a >= 0.30 AND (arm_M_failure_rate_on_axis_a - arm_C_failure_rate_on_axis_a) >= 0.30
c12_broken_rule_v3.subset_b_pass_per_evaluator: subset-(b) gate PASSES for evaluator_e IF AND ONLY IF no axis in {C12-1..C12-8} is BROKEN for evaluator_e
c12_broken_rule_v3.Non_target_Identity_Preservation_per_eva: (G_pres_subset_a_a AND G_pres_subset_a_b) AND (no C12-axis-BROKEN for evaluator_e)
